mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.teacher_name, cl.id classId, cl.class_name FROM t_educl_class cl, t_as_teacher_class c, t_as_teacher t WHERE cl.id = c.class_id AND cl.head_teacher_id = t.id AND c.bind_type = 1 AND cl.is_valid = 1 AND c.is_valid = 1 AND t.is_valid = 1 and c.school_id = #{schoolId} and cl.id = #{classId} limit 1

SELECT CONCAT(IFNULL(g.grade_name, ''), IFNULL(c.class_name, '')) AS className, stu.student_no AS studentNo, stu.student_name AS studentName, stu.gender FROM t_as_teacher_class tc INNER JOIN t_educl_class c ON c.id = tc.class_id AND c.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_grade g ON g.id = c.grade_id AND g.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_student stu ON stu.class_id = c.id AND stu.is_valid = 1 AND stu.register_status = 1 WHERE tc.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND tc.school_id = #{schoolId} AND tc.bind_type = 1 AND tc.is_valid = 1
AND c.id = #{classId}
AND (stu.student_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR stu.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY stu.student_no ASC
